# Social preview guidance

No fake social-preview placeholder is committed. Use the approved final icon at
`Resources/FreeFlowIcon.png`, then create and manually upload the finished
GitHub social preview in **Settings → General → Social preview**.

Use a 1280 × 640 PNG with:

- `Resources/FreeFlowIcon.png` and the FreeFlow name;
- the line “Free, open-source dictation for macOS”;
- a real screenshot of the compact recording pill over a neutral text field;
- a small “Source-only alpha” label;
- no Wispr logo, copied trade dress, private text, API key, personal account
  data, or promise of a prebuilt download.

Also capture a short demo GIF for the README only after the exact flow has been
physically rechecked. Show shortcut-down, the recording pill, shortcut-up, and
the transcript arriving in a disposable field. Keep the Apple Silicon test
scope visible in the caption and do not imply Intel runtime verification.
